d: MLC Election 2026 ki patna snatak aur patna shikshak 'hot siton' par jari matganna ke bich bankipur balika uchch vidyalay sthit mukhy kendr ke bahar us vakt harkanp mach gaya, jab ek sandigdh vyakti ke pas se kaee gupt aadhikarik phailen baramad ki gaeen. prashant kishor ki parti jan suraj ke netaon aur karyakartaon ne aarop lagaya ki in phailon ke andar ati-sanvedanshil 'phorm-16' (Form-16) aur matganna se jure dastavej the, jinhen suraksha niymon ko tak par rakhkar kendr se bahar laya ja raha tha.
